```ts
import { AnimationManager, AnimationGroup, stopAnimation, getAnimationGroups } from "@babylonjs/lite";

export function releaseProperty(manager: AnimationManager, target: object, path: string): void {
    const parts = path.split(".");
    const lastPart = parts[parts.length - 1];
    
    // Walk the path to get the object owning the last part
    let owner: object = target;
    for (let i = 0; i < parts.length - 1; i++) {
        owner = (owner as any)[parts[i]];
        if (owner == null) return; // path doesn't exist, nothing to release
    }
    
    // Get all groups on the manager
    const groups = getAnimationGroups(manager);
    
    for (const group of groups) {
        const targeted = group.targetedAnimations;
        if (!targeted) continue;
        
        for (const ta of targeted) {
            if (ta.target === owner && ta.path === lastPart) {
                stopAnimation(group);
                break; // one match is enough to stop this group
            }
        }
    }
}
```
